sum: General Updates - In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated March 27, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ),…
detail: General Updates - In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated March 27, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ), we would like to inform the exchanges that pursuant to the first and final call notice issued by Everest Buildpro Private Limited ( EBPL ), the Company has paid the first and final call amount of Rs. 1,12,93,02,900/- to EBPL and accordingly, 1,54,150 partly paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10/- each of EBPL held by the Company stands converted into fully paid-up equity shares on October 15, 2026.Prior to and after the aforesaid subscription, the Company shall…
